Field Descriptions

reset_timeout

Live status: high while a pending software reset has exceeded timeout_value (timeout/error flag; set in both modes).

reset_applied

Live status: high while a requested software reset is actually applied at the cluster (drain complete and reset asserted).

timeout_mode

Timeout mode: 0 = give up and report error (stay withheld, do not apply); 1 = force the reset on timeout.

timeout_value

Cycles (clk_smc) a software reset may stay pending (withheld, waiting for drain) before timeout. 0 = disabled, wait indefinitely.
